basics.name: Martin Birkenbaum
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience in designing, building, and deploying scalable Python-based backend services, microservices, and robust GitOps-driven automation systems. Proven expertise in developing high-quality, production-grade software, focusing on code quality, automated testing, and developer toolchains to enhance system reliability and efficiency, including experience relevant to data pipelines and ML infrastructure.

work.name: Initech Corporation
work.summary: Led architecture and development of high-throughput microservices and GitOps-driven infrastructure pipelines.
highlights: Designed and implemented highly scalable Python-based event-driven microservices, processing 10M+ daily events, applicable to high-throughput data pipelines and backend ML infrastructure.
Standardized containerized deployments utilizing Docker, Kubernetes, and GitOps workflows, ensuring reliable and efficient software delivery.
Mentored 6 junior/mid-level engineers, establishing local code styling, quality, and rigorous testing standards, contributing to robust codebases and excellent team communication.
Developed custom internal toolchains and automated verification mechanisms that reduced CI pipeline execution times by 40% and enhanced overall code quality.

work.name: Hooli Inc.
work.summary: Backend engineer focused on building RESTful APIs, developer tooling, and automated deployment integrations.
highlights: Developed robust and scalable REST APIs in Python/Django and TypeScript/Node.js, forming critical backend components for full-stack applications.
Integrated third-party APIs and designed automated webhook processors for external developer platforms, demonstrating expertise in system integration and automation.
Implemented a comprehensive suite of unit and integration tests, raising coverage from 60% to 92%, and establishing high standards for code reliability and quality assurance.
